title: Phase-E per-surface split, recomputed by the Handbook from the cited rollup
status_plain: NOT a live-Excel measurement. Every count in this record was computed by the Handbook by summing the per-bucket totals stored in the rollup artifact that catalogue line 159 cites by path. No OxFunc sentence anywhere states any of these nine per-surface figures. What OxFunc states is the aggregate (EV-FIN-0001). The recomputation reproduces that aggregate exactly -- the 26 buckets sum to 5154 rows, 3117 exact, 1318 at 1 ULP, 542 at 2-16 ULP and 177 above 16 ULP, which is the published quadruple to the digit -- and that reproduction is the only warrant these figures have. The corpus is the same corpus, the predicate is the same predicate, and the replay was of production OxFunc; but the arithmetic is the Handbook's, so these counts may not be shelved beside an oracle run. The split is what makes the aggregate readable: PMT is 4,040 of the 5,154 rows and carries almost none of the catastrophic drift, while the 675 IPMT/PPMT/CUM* schedule rows carry 135 of the 177 rows above 16 ULP. CUMIPMT at 5 of 90 is the worst pass rate in the financial domain and appears in no OxFunc prose at all. The corpus also contains 30 POWER rows, outside this domain, which is why the nine counts below sum to 5,124 and not 5,154.

evidence_locality_note: `smart-fuzzer/.gitignore:1` excludes `runs/*`, so `smart-fuzzer/runs/w109-phase-e-replay/rollup.json` has no git object at commit 473efa3. `git ls-files --error-unmatch` on it returns "Did you forget to 'git add'?". The sha256 in upstream_anchor was therefore computed over the working-tree bytes, and the corpus files it names are outside the repository entirely.
open_question: Whether OxFunc will ever publish this split in prose. Until it does, the strongest per-surface production evidence for four financial surfaces exists only as Handbook arithmetic over an untracked artifact.
reader_warning: NOT a live-Excel measurement. Every figure here is the Handbook's own arithmetic over a stored artifact, not an oracle run, and none of them may sit on the same shelf as an oracle-run count. They may not be described as OxFunc's published figures, because OxFunc publishes only the aggregate. This record must not render without EV-FIN-0001, which carries the aggregate these numbers reproduce.
